JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 10 · The coast home

Sixteen hours out from the Moon, 300,000 km from home, the ship turning slowly in the sunlight. Five hours on comes the walk outside: the hatch is opened, and you go hand over hand along the rail to the instrument bay in the Service Module's side, take the film cassette from the mapping camera and bring it in, the Earth and the Moon both hanging in the black. Then the long fall home, until the Earth fills the window. Sit down in a chair before you start.

In the headset: B runs time faster and A slower (hold A for real time), X is the big window to your left, Y looks from outside. For the walk: A, a grip or the left stick forward takes you out of the hatch; outside, grip and pull yourself along the rail, or push the stick, or let A take you; a grip by the cassette takes it.

On this screen: drag to look, Space start or pause, W faster, S slower, C window, O outside, F out of the hatch and by itself, arrow keys along the rail, G take the cassette, 1–5 jump.
